name: How does Colorado's dry climate affect crown molding installation?

mainEntity.name: How does Colorado's dry climate affect crown molding installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: In the Denver and Aurora metro areas, dry indoor air and seasonal humidity shifts cause framing and trim materials to expand and contract significantly. Acclimating uninstalled wood or MDF boards inside the heated living space for 48 to 72 hours before cutting minimizes future shrinkage and open joints. Installers must use mechanical fasteners driven securely into wall studs and ceiling joists, paired with flexible, high-grade acrylic caulking that can stretch during seasonal dry spells without pulling away from the drywall.
acceptedAnswer.description: Low humidity causes trim to contract. Acclimating materials indoors for several days before installation and using flexible caulk prevents seams from cracking during dry winter months.
